title: Red Dragon on Misty Tracks
description: A vibrant red dragon wearing a white scarf stands on broken railway tracks beside a reflective puddle, overlooking a foggy mountainous landscape at dusk. The scene is framed by a large glowing moon, misty hills, scattered houses, and a border of white line-drawn icons including bones, flowers, gears and tools.
prompt: A cheerful red dragon with a white scarf stands on broken rusty train tracks next to a reflective puddle mirroring the moon. Behind him is a misty green valley with hills, scattered houses, and a large luminous moon in a cloudy sky. The entire circular scene is bordered by white hand-drawn icons of flowers, bones, gears and tools on a dark background, in a detailed fantasy illustration style.
